description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeBulkLeaveRequestAPI' which provides API endpoints for bulk handling of leave requests (approve, cancel, reject) within an HRM system. It includes methods for bulk updating leave request statuses, validation rules, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeBulkLeaveRequestAPI
